tagline.en: DynamiCrafter — animates a still image into a short video, using video diffusion priors, with 512 and 1024 resolution variants.
tagline.zh: DynamiCrafter——借助视频扩散先验把静态图片动画化为短视频,提供 512 与 1024 两种分辨率变体。

en: DynamiCrafter is an image-to-video model that brings a single still image to life, animating it into a short clip. It leverages pretrained video diffusion priors so the generated motion stays coherent with the input image's content.

The public, non-gated Hugging Face releases come in two main resolution variants — a 512 and a 1024 image-to-video runtime — under the Doubiiu account. Note that the model cards don't expose an explicit license, so review the upstream license terms before redistributing.
In WorldFoundry the image-to-video runtimes are wrapped in-tree. You supply a starting image (and prompt), pick the 512 or 1024 route, and it renders the animated video.
zh: DynamiCrafter 是一个图生视频模型,能让一张静态图片动起来,把它动画化为一段短视频。它借助预训练的视频扩散先验,使生成的运动与输入图像内容保持连贯。
其公开、无门槛的 Hugging Face 发布提供两个主要分辨率变体——512 与 1024 的图生视频运行时——位于 Doubiiu 账号下。需要注意:模型卡未标明明确的 license,因此在再分发前请先查阅上游的许可条款。
在 WorldFoundry 中,图生视频运行时以仓库内封装的方式提供。你给出一张起始图片(以及提示词),选择 512 或 1024 路径,它便渲染出动画化的视频。

whenToUse.en: When you want to animate a single still image into a short video and choose between a lighter 512 route and a higher-resolution 1024 route.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想把一张静态图片动画化为短视频,并在更轻量的 512 路径与更高分辨率的 1024 路径之间选择时。

notFor.en: The Hugging Face model cards don't state an explicit license, so review upstream terms before redistribution. Checkpoints are downloaded separately rather than bundled.
notFor.zh: Hugging Face 模型卡未标明明确的 license,再分发前请先查阅上游条款。Checkpoint 需单独下载而非随附。
